limitations: Process counters include all owned fixture threads, not just the UI thread.
GetSystemTimes is aggregate across the caller processor group when multiple groups exist.
Available commit here belongs to the sampler API context, not an exact system-wide commit measurement.
Sampling is observational and can perturb scheduling. CPU and memory correlations do not identify a wait owner or prove causation.
Only the exact child executable is queried; other process identities and command lines are not retained.
